pageDescription: Temporary files, browser and app caches, the Recycle Bin, logs and other traces. See how much you get back and what will be deleted before you confirm; deleted files do not go to the Recycle Bin.
recycleBinProtectedNote: The Recycle Bin is not scanned because it is protected in Settings.
categorySystemDescription: Temporary files, logs, caches, crash dumps and update files
categoryAiToolsDescription: Caches and logs of AI apps
categoryGamingDescription: Launcher and shader caches, redistributable packages
categoryRecycleBinDescription: Files already in the Recycle Bin
categoryShortcutsDescription: Shortcuts to files or folders that no longer exist
categoryEnvironmentDescription: PATH entries and environment variables that point to missing folders
categoryDatabasesDescription: Compacts the SQLite databases of browsers and apps; the data stays
categoryPrivacyTracesDescription: Shell history and recent activity: only the entries you choose
groupOptionalCacheResets: Optional cache resets: the next launch can be slower
maintenanceComponentsNote: Removes older Windows component versions immediately. It can take a while; the space freed is not included in the totals.
maintenanceNativeNote: Uses the built-in cleanup tool; the space freed is not included in the totals.
privacyShellHistoryNote: History files are emptied, not deleted. A shell that is open now may write its session history back when it exits, so close open terminals first.
privacyRecentItemsNote: Removes the shortcuts in your Recent folder. Pinned items and jump lists are kept, so File Explorer's Quick access may still show some recent files. Changes may fully apply after you sign out.
privacyOfficeRecentNote: Removes Office's recent-file shortcuts. The recent list inside each Office app is stored separately and is not changed.
privacyRegistryListNote: Only the entries in this list are removed, after a .reg backup is saved to your SuperSonicCleaner backups folder. File Explorer keeps some lists in memory, so changes may fully apply only after you sign out.
privacyRdpHistoryNote: Removes the list of recently used Remote Desktop computers. Saved usernames and certificates are kept. A .reg backup is saved to your SuperSonicCleaner backups folder first.
privacyMacRecentItemsNote: Deleting these lists is how macOS clears Recent Items. Finder sidebar favourites are kept. Apps that are open may keep showing recent items until they quit or you log out.
privacyMacQuarantineNote: Clears the record of files downloaded from the internet that macOS keeps for Gatekeeper. Downloaded files and their security checks are not affected.
privacyGtkRecentNote: Deleting this file clears the recent files list in GNOME and other GTK apps; it is recreated when needed. Apps that are open may add their recent files back.
privacyKdeRecentNote: Removes the recent document entries used by KDE apps and the Plasma desktop. Apps that are open may add their recent files back.

progress.environmentDone: PATH entries and environment variables read

cancelAfterCategory: Stops after the current category finishes.
scanCancelPending: Stopping after the current category finishes…
nothingFoundTitle: Nothing to clean in the scanned categories
categoriesNotScanned_one: {{count}} category not scanned: it needs administrator rights.
categoriesNotScanned_other: {{count}} categories not scanned: they need administrator rights.
blockersDescription: These apps use files in the selection: if they stay open, those files are skipped.
blockersAutoCloseDescription: These browsers use files in the selection. As set in Settings, they are closed when the cleanup starts.
confirmLimits: This cannot be undone: deleted files do not go to the Recycle Bin. Files in use are skipped.
confirmCloseApps: Close {{apps}} first: the files they use would be skipped.
toastRestorePointSkippedDescription: Windows did not create the restore point; the cleanup continues.
receiptSkipped_one: {{n}} item skipped because it was in use or protected.
receiptSkipped_other: {{n}} items skipped because they were in use or protected.
permissionError: Some files need administrator rights to be deleted.
